extracted.intended_audience: authors and writers seeking literary representation
extracted.subtask_description: A directory-style agent listing that shows a literary agent's manuscript wishlist (genres/categories they are seeking) and their agency affiliation; used by authors to target queries/submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres sought (Cindy Uh)
rubrics_metrics.description: Nonfiction; Children; Picture books; YA; Women's fiction; LGBT; Cookbook; Memoir
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These listed genres indicate the types of manuscripts the agent is interested in receiving; use this to decide whether to query this agent and to tailor your submission to the agent's stated interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agent role and affiliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Cindy Uh — Literary Agent at Creative Artists Agency (CAA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agent title and agency affiliation signal professional representation and where submissions would be placed; authors should note the agency (CAA) when researching submission procedures and expectations.
